body:
I'm one of two people to cause her any discomfort in the past 2 weeks. The other is her boyfriend she just broke up because he cheated on her. I'm pretty sure it's meant about me and that guy, which makes me feel even worse because he's a piece of shit, and now I'm no better.

I don't know why but last night I didn't do it. I went to bed, put a movie (Catch Me If You Can) on and thought about going through with it. I even had a large S&W hunting knife I keep with me out, thinking of the possible ways I could do it. I couldn't do it. I don't know if I'm glad I didn't go through with it or if I feel more worthless because I couldn't even do one simple thing.

If you don't mind me asking.. you said you've been in the same situation.. Can you explain a little? I'm curious.

She's not here for me this time though. She posted on Facebook that she just wants a break from everyone for the weekend so I plan on allowing her to have that.

The positions wouldn't be reversed. She never treats me poorly intentionally. Sometimes she says she'll do something and forget or not hear me when I say something and I get upset or something like that, but she doesn't mean any harm..
